|source=[http://www.afa.org.ar/index.php?option=com_wrapper&view=wrapper&Itemid=96 AFA] }} ==Relegation== Clubs with an indirect affiliation with [[Argentine Football Association]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Rosario Central]], [[Newell's Old Boys]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. The bottom two teams of this table face relegation regardless of their affiliation status. Apart from them, the bottom teams of each affiliation face promotion/relegation playoffs against [[Torneo Argentino A]] and [[Primera B Metropolitana]]'s "Reducido" (reduced tournaments) champions. The Reducidos are played after those leagues' champions are known. {|class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" !width=28|{{Tooltip|Pos|Position}}
